title: SHEIN Black Friday 2026: what to buy, when it starts and how the 4CW5Y code works
seoTitle: SHEIN Black Friday 2026: what to buy and when it starts
description: 17 pieces to look at on SHEIN this Black Friday, with fabric and measurements, six campaign shortcuts, coupons, returns and the 4CW5Y referral code.
metaDescription: SHEIN Black Friday 2026 is Nov 27 and the calendar varies by country. The 4CW5Y referral code opens a selection with promotions and discounts.
imageAlt: Cecília Mauad in two looks from a SHEIN haul: a light blouse tied at the waist with a black midi skirt, and a long black dress with light cut-outs
cons: The percentage in the ad applies to some items, not the whole cart

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Black Friday 2026 falls on November 27, and SHEIN's sale calendar varies by country. This guide lists 17 pieces with fabric and measurements and six campaign shortcuts. Search referral code 4CW5Y in the SHEIN app or on the website to open a selection with promotions and discounts; SHEIN sets the eligible items and savings.

contentSections.heading: When SHEIN's Black Friday starts
paragraphs: The calendar Black Friday is the last Friday of November, the 27th in 2026, and Cyber Monday is the 30th. Those dates do not say when SHEIN starts or ends its deals. In the US, SHEIN announced its [Year-End Sale](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/shein-kicks-off-holiday-shopping-season-with-its-biggest-black-friday--cyber-monday-selection-yet-302914580.html) on October 20, with Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals; the release gives no dates or percentage.

Outside the US, campaigns, dates and discounts change by country, and we found no official calendar for other English-speaking countries: check the campaign on your country's SHEIN site or app. The table shows what SHEIN announced for the US store.

postParagraphs: In 2023, 2024 and 2025, the US announcements extended offers into December. These are historical announcements, not dates for 2026. Compare the final price of the item you want; a campaign maximum does not guarantee its price will fall.

contentSections.heading: The advertised discount and your final price

image.alt: Cecília Mauad in two looks from a SHEIN haul: a light blouse tied at the waist with a black midi skirt, and a long black dress with light cut-outs

paragraphs: An advertised maximum discount applies to eligible items. Check whether the product you want is included and compare its final price:
bullets: Save the items to your wishlist and note today's price before deciding when to buy.
Compare the wishlist price with the later phases.
Look at the final price in the cart, with shipping and taxes, and not only the percentage in the announcement.
If the item comes in a hard-to-find size, don't wait for the last phase: stock may run out first.

contentSections.heading: What to buy: the 17 pieces in one table
paragraphs: These are 17 pieces from the campaign, chosen to cover parties, everyday wear, workouts, the beach, sleepwear, kids, accessories and Christmas. We opened each product page in mid-November: fabric, measurements, rating and the discount shown come from the page that day.

comparisonTable.caption: Discount shown on each product page when we checked. Prices and discounts change during the campaign and can vary by color and size.
rows: [Brown and white top and wide-leg pants set](https://onelink.shein.com/60/68f7jiqz6ysl?ismg_ol=6UKOGxp9311_01_KOC-C)

postParagraphs: We leave prices out on purpose: each link opens the piece in the SHEIN store for your region, with the price in your currency.

Choose the size from each piece's size chart, in centimetres, and not from the letter: sizing changes from brand to brand inside SHEIN. The [SHEIN size guide](/en/reviews/shein-size-guide) shows how to measure yourself and read the chart.

contentSections.heading: Six campaign shortcuts to search in the app
paragraphs: Besides the pieces, SHEIN built themed selections for the campaign. Each one has a search code: type the code into the search bar of the SHEIN app, or open it through the link, and the selection appears. These codes are search shortcuts: they do not go in at checkout and they are not coupons.

comparisonTable.caption: What each selection brings together. The discount shown in each one applies to some items in the selection, never to the whole cart.

postParagraphs: The coupon in the B75N67A selection is for new users only. The cap, the minimum spend and who can use it appear in your account and at checkout.

4CW5Y is something else: it is Cecília's referral code. Searched in the app or on the site, or opened through the link in this guide, it leads to a selection with promotions and discounts, and it works for existing customers too.

Two selections call for care with returns. Lingerie and underwear usually have stricter return rules, and so do cosmetics once the seal is open: check the shade and the ingredient list on the SHEGLAM page before opening, and read your store's return policy before paying.
The M3UP428 selection groups clothes by style and fit. Use it together with the size chart of each piece.

contentSections.heading: Dresses and a two-piece set: parties, vacation and everyday
paragraphs: Three dresses and a two-piece set. Two of the dresses have non-stretch fabric, and in those the bust and waist measurements decide the size.

contentSections.heading: SHEIN BAE spaghetti-strap dress
bullets: Discount shown on the page when we checked: -20%.
Sizes: XXS to XXL, plus a Petite range.
Fabric: 100% polyester, unlined and non-stretch.
Store rating 4.82, with over a thousand reviews.
paragraphs: A spaghetti-strap dress with a full skirt, open back and zipper, in the red the link opens. The size chart runs from an 84 cm bust and 66 cm waist in XXS to 114 cm and 96 cm in XXL, with a length of 122 to 134 cm.

The fabric does not stretch, so the bust and waist have to match your measurements: compare in centimetres before choosing. For other party styles, see the [SHEIN party dress guide](/en/reviews/shein-party-dress-guide).

image.alt: Model wearing the red SHEIN BAE spaghetti-strap dress with a full skirt and gold sandals, photo from the SHEIN product page

items.howTo: With heeled sandals and a small bag, as in the store photo.

contentSections.heading: SHEIN PETITE halter mini dress
bullets: Discount shown on the page when we checked: -20%.
Sizes: Petite XXS to Petite L.
Fabric: 100% polyester, with a lining of 89% polyester and 11% elastane.
Store rating 4.82, with over a thousand reviews.
paragraphs: A halter mini dress that ties at the neck, with an open back and a layered skirt. The link opens the brown color. The SHEIN PETITE line is cut with a shorter torso and length, for women of shorter height.

On the size chart, the length runs from 74 cm in Petite XXS to 79.4 cm in Petite L, and the bust from 75 to 93 cm. Measure from your shoulder to where you want the hem and compare with the chart, because your height changes where a mini ends.

image.alt: Model wearing the brown SHEIN PETITE halter mini dress with a layered skirt, photo from the SHEIN product page

contentSections.heading: Opulessa floral dress
bullets: Discount shown on the page when we checked: -20%.
Sizes: XXS to XL.
Fabric: knit of 91% polyester and 9% elastane, high stretch. The product page lists it as semi-sheer.
Store rating 4.87, with over a thousand reviews.
paragraphs: A long, fitted dress with a yellow and orange floral print, thin straps, a plunging neckline, an open back and a side slit. The length runs from 105 cm in XXS to 115 cm in XL.

With this cut, a regular bra shows. The options that suit the design are going without a bra, a stick-on lift bra or nipple covers: pick the one you already use. Since the knit is semi-sheer, think about the color of your underwear too.

bullets: Discount shown on the page when we checked: -20%.

contentSections.heading: An accessory and Christmas decor
paragraphs: Two small purchases: a set of rings and a Christmas door cover.

bullets: Discount shown on the page when we checked: -20%.

Store rating 4.87, with over a thousand reviews.
paragraphs: Twenty silver-tone rings in different designs, among them a heart, a letter and a braided band, to wear several at once. It also works as a small gift.

It is zinc-alloy costume jewelry: take it off to wash your hands and shower, and store it away from perfume and humidity, which darken the metal. Jewelry can have its own return rules: check the return information on the product page before buying.

Christmas decor is only useful if it arrives before the 24th. The delivery estimate for your address appears on the page before you pay: if the estimated date falls after Christmas, do not buy it for this year.

image.alt: Door covered by the fabric panel printed with a decorated fireplace and the words Merry Christmas, between two Christmas trees, photo from the SHEIN product page

contentSections.heading: Taxes and customs: what your checkout shows
paragraphs: Import duties and sales tax depend on where the order ships and on its value. SHEIN shows the taxes for your order at checkout, before you pay: read that line, because a discount changes the order value and can change the tax too.
If you return an item, check in your order's refund terms whether the taxes you paid come back.

contentSections.heading: Price, currency and stock: check your SHEIN store
paragraphs: The links in this guide open each piece in the SHEIN store for your region. The price, the currency, the sizes in stock and the discount shown can differ from what we saw when we checked.
Before paying, confirm the price in your currency, that your size is available and whether the piece is part of the campaign in your store.

contentSections.heading: Coupons, points and the 4CW5Y code
paragraphs: Under SHEIN's coupon policy, one platform coupon applies per order. Each coupon has an expiry date, and one not used in time becomes unavailable.
The checkout shows how many SHEIN points you can use and the discount they provide. Check that amount before paying.

4CW5Y is not a coupon: it is Cecília's SHEIN referral code, and it does give you a discount. Open SHEIN through Cecília's link and search 4CW5Y in the SHEIN app or on the site: the code opens a page with a selection of recommended products, promotions and discounts. How much and on which items is up to SHEIN and varies. SHEIN campaigns change all the time: check the current ones on the store page here on the site before placing your order.
The six campaign codes in the shortcuts section, such as 24V7643, are also typed into the search bar, but they open SHEIN's themed selections. 4CW5Y is the only one that is Cecília's referral code.

contentSections.heading: Delivery and payment before the holidays
paragraphs: The delivery estimate for your address appears on the product page and again at checkout. For a gift or for Christmas decor, compare that date with the day you need the piece.
Payment methods vary by country. A method that takes days to confirm leaves room for the piece to sell out in the meantime: during the campaign, prefer one that confirms right away.

contentSections.heading: Exchanges and returns after Black Friday
bullets: **Before you buy:** check the return policy for your order, including the deadline, eligible items and return costs.

**For the pieces in this guide:** swimwear, lingerie, jewelry and cosmetics often have their own return rules. Check them in your store's return policy before buying the Costavie swimsuit, the set of rings or anything from the SHEGLAM selection.
**Partial returns:** check how the refund is calculated when a coupon or promotion was used.
**Taxes:** consult the refund terms for your order and destination.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay: what to check
bullets: The garment's measurements in centimetres, compared with your own.
Whether the coupon went through and the points were applied.
The delivery time, if the purchase is a Christmas present.
The return deadline, eligible items and return costs for your order.
paragraphs: **Shipping:** check the delivery charge for your address and the conditions of any free shipping offer in the cart.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: When does SHEIN's Black Friday start and how long does it last? Black Friday 2026 falls on November 27. SHEIN's US Year-End Sale release includes seasonal offers but does not specify campaign dates. Check the campaign displayed in the store before buying.
How does SHEIN's Black Friday work? Offers may have different dates and conditions. Check which items qualify for the advertised discount and compare the final price in the cart.

Does SHEIN have Cyber Monday? Cyber Monday 2026 falls on November 30. SHEIN's 2026 US release includes Cyber Monday deals, without dates. For other countries, we found no announcement: check the campaign on your country's SHEIN site.
Will a Black Friday order arrive before Christmas? We can't guarantee a date. The delivery estimate appears in your order before you pay: check it on every purchase.

Is 4CW5Y a discount coupon? It is not a coupon, but it does give you a discount: it is Cecília's SHEIN referral code. Open SHEIN through the link and search for the code in the app or on the site: the code opens a selection of products with promotions and discounts; how much and on which items is up to SHEIN.

Are 4CW5Y and SHEIN's campaign codes the same thing? No. 4CW5Y is Cecília's referral code. Codes such as 24V7643 and B75N67A are SHEIN shortcuts that open campaign selections in the app's search. None of them goes in at checkout.

Do the pieces in this guide cost the same in every country? No. Each link opens the piece in the SHEIN store for your region, with its own price, currency and stock. Check the price on the product page before paying.

How do I choose my size for SHEIN clothes on Black Friday? Use the size chart of each piece, in centimetres, and compare it with your own measurements. Sizing changes from brand to brand inside SHEIN, and non-stretch fabric calls for more attention to the bust and waist.
